title: Garmin Run Marathon Series Philippines 2026 Review: A GPS Brand at SM MOA
seo_title: Garmin Run Philippines 2026 Review | SM Mall of Asia
meta_description: Garmin Run Marathon Series Philippines 2026 review: October 25 at SM Mall of Asia -- the Philippine leg of Garmin's regional running series.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026 at SM Mall of Asia Complex, this Philippine leg of the Garmin Run Marathon Series is organised by HyveSports at the country's largest mall, with registration already open.
verdict: The Garmin Run Marathon Series' Philippine leg brings the same premium GPS-watch brand identity seen at the Indonesia leg covered elsewhere in this research batch, here organised by HyveSports at SM Mall of Asia -- the Philippines' largest mall and a proven large-scale event venue used repeatedly across this research (Decathlon Run, Sunnies Run, Sante Barley Trilogy's Manila leg). Three distances (21.1K/10K/5K) and open registration make this a straightforward pick for runners already invested in Garmin's ecosystem, or simply drawn to a well-resourced brand production at a landmark venue.

sections.heading: Garmin's Philippine Leg, Registration Open
paragraphs: The Philippine leg of the Garmin Run Marathon Series is organised by HyveSports at SM Mall of Asia Complex, Pasay, offering 21.1K, 10K and 5K distances. [1] Registration is already open, ahead of several other newer or unannounced races in this research batch.

sections.heading: A Familiar Formula: Tech Brand, Data-Driven Racing
paragraphs: As with the Garmin Run Asia Series' Indonesia leg covered elsewhere in this research, Garmin is one of the most recognised GPS sports-watch brands globally, and races under its name typically lean into device demos and data-driven pacing features. [1] That gives this event a distinct appeal for runners already using Garmin gear, or curious to try it.

sections.heading: A Proven Large-Scale Venue
paragraphs: SM Mall of Asia is the Philippines' largest shopping mall by floor area, on reclaimed land along Manila Bay, and has already hosted multiple races covered in this research batch -- the Decathlon Run, Sunnies Run, and Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia's Manila leg among them. [2] That repeat use as a race venue speaks to genuinely proven infrastructure for handling large fields.

sections.heading: HyveSports as Organiser
paragraphs: The event is run by HyveSports rather than RunRio, the organiser behind most other Philippine races in this research batch -- a different operational team, though the venue's track record with other organisers is a reasonable proxy for what to expect logistically. [1]

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a Garmin-branded, data-focused race at the Philippines' largest and most tested mall venue appeals, the Philippine leg of the Garmin Run Marathon Series on 25 October 2026 is a solid, low-risk pick with registration already open.
